{"question_target":"T06","reply":"Yes. Your two main options are:

1. Original Medicare: Parts A and B through the federal program. You can add a separate drug plan, and you may be able to add Medigap.
2. Medicare Advantage: a private plan that provides your Part A and Part B instead. Most plans include drug coverage, and doctors, costs, and rules vary by plan.
